fields.Name: IT14 - Predictive Studio Stack Seams
fields.Description: Live, full-stack (headless) coverage of Predictive Studio's STACK SEAMS over the real provider — deterministic + sidecar-free (only an internal PS5 live-train leg is gated behind PS_INTEGRATION=1). PS1: ML entity CRUD round-trips through SQLServerDataProvider with typed fields intact (Pipeline/Model/Scoring Binding). PS2: the pipeline ↔ model ↔ binding FK lineage reads back correctly. PS3: the 'ML Model' Record Set Processing work type resolves the MLModelInferenceProcessor through the substrate's pluggable RecordProcessorRegistry (the exact seam RecordProcessExecutor.buildProcessor falls through to). PS4: the four PS Actions (Train / Score / Run Experiment / Promote) exist in metadata with their params + result codes and the @RegisterClass drivers resolve. PS5: invoking Train ML Model with a missing PipelineID fails cleanly (VALIDATION_ERROR, no throw). PS6: ML Component Type CRUD round-trips INCLUDING the hierarchy columns a self-referencing FK only emits when opted into hierarchy support — the failure mode that renders as an empty grid rather than an error. PS7: MLComponentEngine resolves inherited profiles over the SHIPPED seed component tree (union, override-nearest and Replace semantics, with provenance) and lintComponentTree reports zero Error/Warning findings on it. PS8: the Model → Component → Binding → Entity Field meaning chain reads back, and the server-side guard refuses to instantiate an abstract component type. Creates + deletes all its own ML fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: ML entities round-trip with typed fields; the 'ML Model' work-type seam resolves the scoring processor; the four PS Actions are registered; a missing-PipelineID train fails cleanly; the component tree reads back with its hierarchy columns, resolves inherited profiles, lints clean, and binds model inputs to real entity fields.
